race.title: PricedUp Boosts And BOG Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Not much to separate BURNING EMBERS and Reflection Of You , with Dan Skelton's unexposed 5-y-o narrowly preferred. Fireball Frenzy and It's Maisy also merit consideration in a tight-looking handicap. BURNING EMBERS (IRE) REFLECTION OF YOU FIREBALL FRENZY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Burning Embers (7/2), Briery Butterfly (11/2), Bits Ballou (11/2), Diamond Grace (6/1), Seasmoke (6/1), Reflection Of You (7/1), Fireball Frenzy (15/2), It's Maisy (8/1)
